cd /tmp/obench-cell-gq7u0n86/bench_opencode_sam-cell-seg_kd_tk4sh; cat > _test/check.py <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, cv2
img=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'); H,W=img.shape[:2]
a=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0); b=pd.read_csv('_test/out/demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0)
def m(r):
    x=list(map(int,str(r.coords_x).split(','))); y=list(map(int,str(r.coords_y).split(',')))
    z=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(z,[np.array(list(zip(x,y)))],1); return z.astype(bool),x,y
cnt=np.zeros((H,W),int); bad=0; ious=[]
vis=img.copy()
for (i,ra),(_,rb) in zip(a.iterrows(),b.iterrows()):
    mb,x,y=m(rb); cnt+=mb
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(mb.astype(np.uint8),connectivity=8)
    if n!=2: bad+=1; print('noncontig',i,n)
    if len(set(zip(x,y)))<=4: print('rect?',i)
    assert rb.xmin==min(x) and rb.xmax==max(x) and rb.ymin==min(y) and rb.ymax==max(y)
    if ra.type=='polyline':
        ma,_,_=m(ra); ious.append((ma&mb).sum()/(ma|mb).sum())
    cv2.polylines(vis,[np.array(list(zip(x,y)))],True,(0,255,0),1)
    xa=list(map(int,str(ra.coords_x).split(',')));ya=list(map(int,str(ra.coords_y).split(',')))
    cv2.polylines(vis,[np.array(list(zip(xa,ya)))],True,(0,0,255),1)
print('overlap px (fillPoly incl. boundary):',(cnt>1).sum(),'noncontig',bad)
print('IoU vs orig polylines: mean %.3f min %.3f'%(np.mean(ious),np.min(ious)))
print((a.drop(columns=['xmin','xmax','ymin','ymax','coords_x','coords_y','type'])==b.drop(columns=['xmin','xmax','ymin','ymax','coords_x','coords_y','type'])).all().all())
cv2.imwrite('_test/vis.png',cv2.resize(vis,None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST))
EOF
